name: clock
title: Clock
description: The date and time on the bar, and a popover with the time to the second, the month with the week numbers, and world clocks for the cities you work with. A day opens in Calendar.
author: pal

settings.label: World clocks
settings.description: One per line: a city (Tokyo, New York), a zone (Europe/Berlin), or a label of your own (Office = Europe/London). `z` in the popover adds one.

store.tagline: The time on the bar, the month and world clocks a click away
features: The date and time on the menu bar or sketchybar, on the minute, with seconds if you like
A click opens the time to the second, the date, the week number and the day of the year
The month with today filled; arrows walk the days, `[` and `]` the months, `t` comes back
World clocks: the time in each city, how far ahead or behind, a moon at night and `tomorrow` when the date has turned
`z` adds a city by name (Tokyo, New York) or zone; Enter opens the day in Calendar

screenshots.caption: Clock in the panel, from root search: the time and the world clocks beside the month
A 12-hour clock and weeks from Sunday, two settings; the ring walked into October, the header saying how far
On the menu bar: the day and the time, turning on the minute
The weekday alone and the seconds, two settings of the item
A click opens the time to the second with the date and the week, the month with today filled, and the world clocks with a moon where it is night
The arrows walk the days and the month's header says how far; Enter opens the day in Calendar
z adds a world clock: a city, a zone, or a name of your own
On sketchybar: the same label, in place of the stock clock
